name: Roc
descr: A giant falcon that nests in the mountains and unleashes storms.

data.motivesAndTactics: Breathe lightning and speak thunder, protect eggs, rake with talons, spy from afar

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Roc can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Bird of Prey
features.text: Once per GM turn, the Roc can move up to Very Far range before or after it takes an action.

features.name: Here Comes the Boom
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Roc unleash a storm of lightning and thunder. Make an attack roll against **1d4+1** targets within Far range. Targets the Roc succeeds against take **3d12** magic damage. Then each target within Far range of the Roc must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take **3d8** physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Crushing Grasp
features.text: When the Roc makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Roc crush the target with its talons, forcing them to mark **1d4** Stress and _Restraining_ them until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20).

features.name: Nest Warden
features.text: When the Roc's eggs are threatened, it gains the following features:

features.name: Wrathful
features.text: The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.

features.name: Electrifying Aura
features.text: The Roc has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark **1d4** Stress.
